# Version 4.155.0
> **Text shaping and cache reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155 previews Skia m155, HarfBuzz 14.4, and Ganesh cache and Linux font-matching corrections.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use an external RAW decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **Skia m155** — Updates the engine to milestone 155 while preserving rotation-scale text-run bounds and the existing managed binding surface. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081))
- **HarfBuzz 14.4.0** — Updates the native shaping engine with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping and subsetting performance work. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## API Surface

- **OpenType value tags** — Adds documented OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enum values. The native raw-value fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed-flush cache cleanup** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))
- **Respect fontconfig candidate ranking** — Tests family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate so a lower-ranked metric-compatible substitute does not prevent trying the next requested family. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.4.0, including cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping and subsetting improvements. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.

## Release Candidate 1 (October 12, 2026)

Corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and first-candidate matching in Linux fontconfig.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13...v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)
